claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the oil as pure and high quality, noting it works well on hair, skin, and nails.
Many customers find it effective for moisturizing skin and softening hair, with some reporting it resolved dandruff.
Several reviewers consider it a good value, especially given the large 4oz bottle size.
A few reviewers complain the oil is too thick, greasy, or slow to absorb, leaving hair and skin oily.
Some customers report issues with the bottle pump, saying it drips or is inefficient.
